architecture_contract.warning: The official hidden and latent defaults change with the fold-specific region count. The campaign must freeze explicit dimensions after the training-only peak contract is fixed; it cannot allow fold or model-specific implicit defaults to alter capacity silently.

embedding_contract.selection_rule: PeakVI has no universal upstream checkpoint and therefore no zero-shot representation lane. Its common representation is a locally trained, fold-confined posterior mean. Native accessibility and transfer functions are reported separately.
embedding_contract.warning: load_query_data updates a reference model on query features. It is forbidden for sealed evaluation unless query adaptation is prospectively authorized, outcome-blind, and applied identically to all eligible methods.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No upstream PeakVI checkpoint is admitted. Every model is initialized and trained inside the outer donor partition; every local artifact receives a project SHA-256.

input_contract.feature_alignment: identical ordered region inventory for reference and query; region identity is a frozen GRCh38.p14 coordinate tuple plus project row ID
input_contract.likelihood_use: Counts are accepted but the reconstruction target is x>0, so count magnitude is discarded by the native likelihood.
input_contract.peak_definition: training-partition-only consensus peaks with held donors excluded from peak calling, filtering, region-frequency estimates, and feature selection
input_contract.reference: GRCh38.p14 for all benchmark interoperability even though PeakVI itself consumes a matrix rather than nucleotide sequence
input_contract.warning: A union peak set defined using held donors leaks their assay features. Query matrices may be projected only to the training-frozen region inventory; absent and structurally unavailable regions remain explicit missingness states before any supported projection.

source_evidence: The exact scvi-tools 1.5.0.post1 tag, source, license, official PeakVI documentation, and PyPI metadata were queried on 2026-08-22. The package was not installed and no model was trained or loaded.

task_fit.development_only_candidate: ATAC cell-representation and donor-compatible integration benchmark after a separate TaskSpec freezes rows, region inventory, labels, metrics, and no-champion scope
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: ineligible for the current profile endpoint because native inference consumes observed ATAC rather than RNA/context-only input
task_fit.sealed_cell_state_mapping: ineligible because GSE289173 exposes RNA-only rows
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: ineligible as a standalone sequence or signed regulatory-effect model because PeakVI has no nucleotide input and no allele-effect mechanism
